comments.author: Kain067
comments.body_html:
Not sure too many people want this mod… would you consider doing something a bit different?

How about you can set a % chance that any item in your inventory (optionally including or not secure containers) is deleted on death.

Would be kind of like Revingly’s Never Lose Equipments except you could set a chance for any item to be deleted… so for example if you have it set to 10% then any item on you would have a 10% chance of being deleted and a 90% chance of not. People could then make it as hardcore or as softcore as they like. I would love that type of mod even more than NLE.

comments.author: sgtlaggy
comments.body_html: Someone sent me a DM requesting this feature, it was added in the 2.1.0 update.

comments.author: Kain067
comments.body_html:
I kind of see that, but it only applies to items in the secure container, right? What I’m requesting is that the percent chance applies to ALL equipped items (and ideally with an option of excluding the secure container, like the base game). So in other words if I set it to 10, I have a 10% chance of any item on me (helmet, armor, gun, items in backpack, the backpack itself) being lost, but a 0% chance of items in my secured container (and special slots) of being lost.

So it’s kind of like mixing Never Lose Equipments with your current mod (into an ideal mod!). But your current percent chances only apply to items in secure container and special slots, right?

comments.author: sgtlaggy
comments.body_html: That is correct. In that case, doesn’t seem to be within the scope of this mod. If someone wants to combine the mod concepts, they’re more than welcome.

comments.author: Dycotomaskey413
comments.body_html:
SPT_Data==>Server==>configs==>lostondeath.json

allows you to designate whether you loose the item in that slot or not on death as well as quest items

comments.author: sgtlaggy
comments.body_html:
Enabling the setting for special slots there didn’t do anything, at least on 3.8.3. I kept special slot items (DSP and multitool) when I died.

If it did work, you could softlock yourself if you ever died with your DSP and no longer be able to access Lightkeeper unless I’m unaware of a way to reacquire it.

Enabling the setting for secure container there deletes the container itself, not just its contents.
